description: What a correct recap of the synthetic call (experiments/synthetic-call/script.json) must contain. Turn numbers index script.json's turns from 0. Speakers are the script's A, B and C, which the pipeline's default mapping names Speaker A, Speaker B and Speaker C. `accept` lists the recap sections where an item counts as correctly placed; `owner` and `due` are null when the call never states them.
